arc: Avoid unnecessarily stopping mini containers. For performance, in login screen, session manager spins up Android container without mounting data partition, and continue booting after entering a user session. If the user has not enabled ARC, the container is turned down soon after login. Since ARC is not enabled initially for test accounts, there is a race condition that Android container can be turned down soon after a user session starts. While full Android container will be started soon, it is completely waste of time. This CL changes the way to enable ARC from a private JS API to a Chrome command line flag. This flag makes Chrome enable ARC regardless of user prefs, so a mini container is never turned down. tast: Improve logging of warnings while collecting sys info. Make the tast process drop a wordy "Error collecting system info:" prefix when logging warnings reported by local_test_runner while collecting system information. Also make local_test_runner include full paths in warnings about crash files (which are typically just generated when some files are skipped due to an excessive number of crashes). For example, messages like "Error collecting system info: skipping; too many files" will now instead be "/var/spool/crash/foo.dmp: skipping; too many files". CHROMIUM: media: imx319: Change sensor settings Change imx319 settings: 1. Use single PLL mode. In the driver, pixel rate is calculated based on MIPI clock. While using dual pll mode, MIPI clock is in a different clock domain from signal processing. As a result, pixel rate cannot be calculated from MIPI clock. Single pll mode is also recommended in imx319 datasheet. 2. Adjust frame length lines to make frame rate at slightly below 30fps(29.99fps) for all modes. Some CTS test cases strictly calculate the frame rate and expects the result to be no larger than 30fps. Limits the frame rate at slightly below 30fps can make sure these CTS cases can pass.
